sentences.text: In a study of animal larvae, researchers identified a distinct buccal-exposed olfactory epithelium absent in other developmental stages, alongside an additional sensory epithelium closely connected to the main olfactory epithelium.

These sensory epithelia exhibited unique anatomical features and projected to specific regions of the main and accessory olfactory bulbs, where immunohistochemistry revealed receptor neurons expressing Gαo with axons targeting these same bulb areas.
The authors concluded that larvae possess specialized olfactory structures not found in other stages, though these findings apply strictly to the animal model examined.
